Duck Hunt vs Villager: do not stop using projectiles

Villager can Pocket Duck Hunt's projectiles and return them with a 1.9x damage multiplier. The obvious reaction is to stop throwing things. でもそれでは、Pocketが一度も成功していないのに自分でDuck Huntのゲームを消してしまう。Pocket has a defined timing window: invulnerability on frames 5–23 and projectile capture on 8–23. This essay reframes the matchup as a fight over when projectiles matter, not whether they exist.
